unlisted_practices: Describe testing and validation cohorts precisely according to REMARK guidelines in computational pathology studies.
Critically evaluate and describe pathologist annotations, from case and block selection to cell-level annotations.
Match WHO entity-specific essential and desirable diagnostic criteria with the applied computational approach.
Delineate algorithm limitations by including known differential diagnoses, mimickers and pitfalls as a separate challenging case series.
Close the loop with a final evaluation of computational versus conventional pathological features.
Display computational results back to pathologists and verify correct application of diagnostic criteria to maintain fidelity in human-machine interactions.
Involve pathologists in human-in-the-loop iterative machine learning to evaluate computational results and provide ground truth.

screen.reason: Editorial discussing the role of pathologists, annotations, human-in-the-loop approaches, and governance/fidelity in computational pathology research and deployment.
